name: Steve Stevenson
source:
Steve was just an ordinary schoolboy until one day he woke up and suddenly found that he was a sparkling animess in animess rand, where everyone is a kawaii sparkling animess. At first he was frightened by the strange big-eyed creatures who suddenly populated his world, but over time he grew to love them and discovered that animess rand is a beautiful place, because once you enter animess rand you can never leave.

[From [url=http://animerand.blogspot.com/2009/05/this-is-development-blog-for-visual.html]Official Site[/url]]
